subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · Terminale · Débat et synthèse
description: Nuancer, réfuter, synthétiser et formuler des hypothèses complexes.

cards.front: Exprime un accord nuancé : « C’est vrai dans une certaine mesure. »
cards.back: That is true to some extent.

cards.front: Introduis un contre-argument sans être catégorique.
cards.back: One could argue, however, that… / That said, …

cards.front: Traduis : « Cet argument repose sur l’idée discutable que… »
cards.back: This argument relies on the questionable assumption that…

cards.front: Formule une conclusion prudente à partir des preuves.
cards.back: The available evidence suggests that…, although…
Both documents highlight…, although they approach it from different perspectives.

cards.front: Complète : If they ___ earlier, they ___ the crisis. (act / avoid)
cards.back: If they had acted earlier, they might have avoided the crisis.

cards.front: Complète : If we had invested earlier, the system ___ safer now. (be)
cards.back: If we had invested earlier, the system would be safer now.

cards.front: Traduis : « Ils auraient dû anticiper ce risque. »
cards.back: They should have anticipated this risk.

cards.front: Reformule sans if : If they had known, they would have acted.
cards.back: Had they known, they would have acted.

cards.front: Donne une conclusion équilibrée et formelle.
cards.back: On balance, the proposal appears beneficial, provided that adequate safeguards are introduced.
